tables.name: injectors
tables.description: Water-injection time series per injector well, subzone and sector

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Injector well name. Unique identifier for the injector well

columns.name: WATER_INJECTION_VOLUME
columns.description: Injected water volume for the period.

columns.name: SUBZONE
columns.description: Subzone name. A subzone indicates vertical interval
business_rules: Expected values include labels such as LW, RW, UW, Unique.

columns.name: SECTOR
columns.description: Sector identifier. A sector indicates a geographical location
business_rules: Should be an integer sector id.

columns.name: YEAR
business_rules: If present, should match the year extracted from DATE.

columns.name: MONTH
business_rules: If present, should match the month extracted from DATE (1-12).

columns.name: DAY
business_rules: If present, should match the day extracted from DATE.

relationships.description: Map injector activity to static well metadata.

columns.name: DATE
business_rules: Represents the observation date/time for the measurement record.
Should align with YEAR/MONTH/DAY when those date-part columns are present.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Producer well name. Unique identifier for the producer well
business_rules: Join key to locations.NAME.
For valid producer records, the matching locations row must have WELL_TYPE = 'Producer'.

columns.name: LIQUID_VOLUME
business_rules: Must be non-negative.
Approximately equals WATER_VOLUME + OIL_VOLUME + GAS_VOLUME, allowing small numerical differences.

columns.name: WATER_VOLUME
business_rules: Must be non-negative.

columns.name: GAS_VOLUME
business_rules: Must be non-negative.

columns.name: OIL_VOLUME
business_rules: Must be non-negative.

columns.name: SUBZONE
columns.description: Subzone name. A subzone indicates vertical interval
business_rules: Expected values include labels such as LW, RW, UW, Unique.

columns.name: SECTOR
columns.description: Sector identifier. A sector indicates a vertical section
business_rules: Should be an integer sector id.

columns.name: YEAR
business_rules: If present, should match the year extracted from DATE.

columns.name: MONTH
business_rules: If present, should match the month extracted from DATE (1-12).

columns.name: DAY
business_rules: If present, should match the day extracted from DATE.

relationships.description: Map producer activity to static well metadata.

tables.name: locations
tables.description: Static well metadata and spatial coordinates.

columns.name: NAME
business_rules: Primary join key to producers.NAME and injectors.NAME.
The well name column is always NAME.

columns.name: X
business_rules: Coordinate used for well location mapping.

columns.name: Y
business_rules: Coordinate used for well location mapping.

columns.name: SUBZONE
business_rules: Expected values include labels such as LW, RW, UW, Unique.

columns.name: SECTOR
business_rules: Should be an integer sector id.

columns.name: WELL_TYPE
business_rules: Allowed values: 'Producer' or 'Injector'.
Each well is either Producer or Injector, never both.
Every well in locations must appear in exactly one of producers or injectors.

relationships.description: Link location rows classified as Injector to injector activity.
Link location rows classified as Producer to producer activity.

query_catalog.question: Show monthly aggregated water injection for each subzone.
query_catalog.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', i.DATE) AS month, i.SUBZONE, SUM(i.WATER_INJECTION_VOLUME) AS total_water_injection FROM injectors i GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', i.DATE), i.SUBZONE ORDER BY month, i.SUBZONE;
query_catalog.notes: Uses strftime('%Y-%m', DATE) for monthly aggregation.

query_catalog.question: What is the average distance between an injector and its closest producer in each sector?
query_catalog.sql: WITH injector_points AS (  SELECT l.NAME AS injector_name, l.SECTOR, l.X, l.Y   FROM locations l   WHERE l.WELL_TYPE = 'Injector'), producer_points AS (  SELECT l.NAME AS producer_name, l.SECTOR, l.X, l.Y   FROM locations l   WHERE l.WELL_TYPE = 'Producer'), nearest AS (  SELECT i.SECTOR, i.injector_name,          MIN(SQRT(POWER(i.X - p.X, 2) + POWER(i.Y - p.Y, 2))) AS nearest_distance   FROM injector_points i   JOIN producer_points p ON p.SECTOR = i.SECTOR   GROUP BY i.SECTOR, i.injector_name) SELECT SECTOR, AVG(nearest_distance) AS avg_nearest_producer_distance FROM nearest GROUP BY SECTOR ORDER BY SECTOR;
query_catalog.notes: Distance is Euclidean using X/Y coordinates and restricted to producers in the same sector.

query_catalog.question: List the top 10 injectors by total injected water volume.
query_catalog.sql: SELECT i.NAME, SUM(i.WATER_INJECTION_VOLUME) AS total_injection FROM injectors i GROUP BY i.NAME ORDER BY total_injection DESC LIMIT 10;

query_catalog.question: Track monthly water injection trends by sector.
query_catalog.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', i.DATE) AS month, i.SECTOR, SUM(i.WATER_INJECTION_VOLUME) AS total_water_injection FROM injectors i GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', i.DATE), i.SECTOR ORDER BY month, i.SECTOR;
query_catalog.notes: Uses strftime('%Y-%m', DATE) for monthly aggregation.

query_catalog.question: Show monthly aggregated oil production for each subzone.
query_catalog.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', p.DATE) AS month, p.SUBZONE, SUM(p.OIL_VOLUME) AS total_oil_volume FROM producers p GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', p.DATE), p.SUBZONE ORDER BY month, p.SUBZONE;
query_catalog.notes: Uses strftime('%Y-%m', DATE) for monthly aggregation.

query_catalog.question: Compute average water cut by producer.
query_catalog.sql: SELECT p.NAME, AVG(CASE WHEN p.LIQUID_VOLUME = 0 THEN NULL          ELSE p.WATER_VOLUME * 1.0 / p.LIQUID_VOLUME END) AS avg_water_cut FROM producers p GROUP BY p.NAME ORDER BY avg_water_cut DESC;
query_catalog.notes: Water cut is WATER_VOLUME / LIQUID_VOLUME with division-by-zero protection.

query_catalog.question: Show total oil and water production per producer with coordinates.
query_catalog.sql: SELECT p.NAME, l.X, l.Y, SUM(p.OIL_VOLUME) AS total_oil_volume, SUM(p.WATER_VOLUME) AS total_water_volume FROM producers p JOIN locations l   ON p.NAME = l.NAME AND l.WELL_TYPE = 'Producer' GROUP BY p.NAME, l.X, l.Y ORDER BY total_oil_volume DESC;
query_catalog.notes: Ensures producer rows map only to Producer entries in locations.

query_catalog.question: Compare injected water to produced oil by sector and month.
query_catalog.sql: WITH inj AS (  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', i.DATE) AS month, l.SECTOR,          SUM(i.WATER_INJECTION_VOLUME) AS inj_water   FROM injectors i   JOIN locations l ON i.NAME = l.NAME AND l.WELL_TYPE = 'Injector'   GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', i.DATE), l.SECTOR), prod AS (  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', p.DATE) AS month, l.SECTOR,          SUM(p.OIL_VOLUME) AS prod_oil   FROM producers p   JOIN locations l ON p.NAME = l.NAME AND l.WELL_TYPE = 'Producer'   GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', p.DATE), l.SECTOR), keys AS (  SELECT month, SECTOR FROM inj   UNION   SELECT month, SECTOR FROM prod) SELECT k.month, k.SECTOR, i.inj_water, p.prod_oil,        CASE WHEN p.prod_oil = 0 OR p.prod_oil IS NULL THEN NULL             ELSE i.inj_water * 1.0 / p.prod_oil END AS inj_to_oil_ratio FROM keys k LEFT JOIN inj i ON i.month = k.month AND i.SECTOR = k.SECTOR LEFT JOIN prod p ON p.month = k.month AND p.SECTOR = k.SECTOR ORDER BY k.month, k.SECTOR;
query_catalog.notes: Uses strftime for month buckets and CASE WHEN to guard ratio division by zero.

query_catalog.question: Find any rows with invalid WELL_TYPE values (should return zero rows).
query_catalog.sql: SELECT l.NAME, l.WELL_TYPE FROM locations l WHERE l.WELL_TYPE IS NULL    OR l.WELL_TYPE NOT IN ('Injector', 'Producer');
query_catalog.notes: Valid results are an empty set when domain constraints are enforced.

semantic_constraints: WELL_TYPE domain is restricted to exactly two values: 'Injector' and 'Producer'.
Each well belongs to exactly one WELL_TYPE category (mutually exclusive).
Well identifiers are stored in NAME and used consistently as join keys across tables.
injectors.NAME joins to locations.NAME only for rows where locations.WELL_TYPE = 'Injector'.
producers.NAME joins to locations.NAME only for rows where locations.WELL_TYPE = 'Producer'.
All volume measures are non-negative (WATER_INJECTION_VOLUME, LIQUID_VOLUME, WATER_VOLUME, OIL_VOLUME, GAS_VOLUME).
Production balance constraint: LIQUID_VOLUME is approximately WATER_VOLUME + OIL_VOLUME + GAS_VOLUME (allowing small numerical tolerance).
If YEAR, MONTH, DAY are present, they should match the corresponding DATE components.
